title: Investigating the Failure Modes of the AUC metric and Exploring Alternatives for Evaluating Systems in Safety Critical Applications
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on evaluating the selective answering capabilities of machine learning models in safety-critical applications using metrics other than the standard Area Under the Curve (AUC).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic is outside its scope.
